body.content:
Hi Tony Chen please make sure you take the details of the RH-Quality callout (email) when making a new CAP and start a conversation
 
(like below) - that way we can identify each issue easily

SUB-ISSUE  
DETAILS slight bowing on the right door, which is not allows the doors to be even
PO NUMBER
Hello Pak Felix - Please see below Davos CAP Tracker from my side
Thanks Efri - I’ll review and keep you posted

Hello Efri, Tony and Ramon
As we continuously having customer claims and complaint as we move forward, we need to make sure we are still using this file to track any claims or complaints, especially to include those RH claimed and complained, because eventually this is a great tool for all of us and can be shared externally to identify the trends on our own. The attached is the template that I created a while ago for monitoring all Davos call-out and the CAP associated with each of the call-out. 
Every issue starts with pictures, issue created date and what are the corrective action plans to self explain how and when do we correct them to prevent such issues from reoccurring again. 
We should be also reviewing this file with each factories periodically and to ensure they are still implementing and executing the CAP we’ve alined so we don’t miss any of the steps throughout the production processes. 
I would like all of you to please start to build the tracker by collection and factory,  please reach out to me if you have questions.
Efri Yandi
  1. Davos Bedroom
  2. Harbour production at PTK/Indonesia
Tony Cheng
  1. Davos Living, Case, Dining
  2. Harbour production at Shayne
Ramon Meng
  1. Balmain Dining, Occasional (HAF)
  2. Balmain Dining chair, Stool  (Aboo)
  3. 1950 Danish Stool (Aboo)
  4. Reade Dining Chair, Stool (Aboo)
  5. Harbour production at Aboo
Carol
  1. Please review and study the file as you can start to build up for Travertine go forward
  2. Davos Handle
Timeline: I want to see your completed tracker sent back to me by 30th November so we can review and go through.
